# Filers: Update Filer

Area overview and notes: [filers.md](../filers.md)

`PATCH /filers/{id}` · tenant-scoped token

Updates an existing filer.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | The unique identifier (UUID) for the Filer. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | No | The legal name of the Filer. |
| `address` | object | No |  |
| `address.first_line` | string | No | First line of the Filer's address. |
| `address.second_line` | string | No | Second line of the Filer's address. Requires `first_line` to be provided. |
| `address.city` | string | No | City. |
| `address.state_or_province` | string | No | State or province. |
| `address.postal_code` | string | No | Postal code. |
| `address.country` | string | No | Two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. |
| `tin` | string | No | The Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the Filer. Used for international reporting regimes. Format is validated in tandem with tax_country_code and the error response indicates the expected format if validation fails. Nullable. |
| `ein` | string | No | The Employer Identification Number (EIN) of the Filer. Primarily used for US tax reporting. Must match format XX-XXXXXXX, XXX-XX-XXXX, or 9 digits. Dashes are stripped on storage and the returned value is always 9 digits. Nullable. |
| `tax_country_code` | string | No | The two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country the Filer is subject to taxes in. |
| `vat_id` | string | No | The Value Added Tax (VAT) identification number of the Filer. Format is validated in tandem with vat_country and the error response indicates the expected format if validation fails. Once stored, the masked value can be retrieved via vat_id_masked. Nullable. |
| `vat_country` | string | No | The two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country the Filer's VAT is registered in. Set to null to clear. Nullable. |
| `contact_name` | string | No | The name of the Filer's contact person. Set to null to clear. Nullable. |
| `contact_title` | string | No | The job title of the Filer's contact person. Set to null to clear. Nullable. |
| `contact_email` | string (email) | No | The email address of the Filer's contact person. Set to null to clear. Nullable. |
| `contact_phone` | string | No | The phone number of the Filer's contact person, in E.164 format. Set to null to clear. Nullable. |
| `giin` | string | No | The Global Intermediary Identification Number (GIIN) of the Filer. Set to null to clear. Nullable. |
| `arn` | string | No | The ATO Reference Number (ARN) of the Filer. Used for Australia SERR reporting. Must be exactly 12 numeric digits. Nullable. |
| `rtn` | string | No | The Routing Transit Number (RTN) of the Filer. Reported in the optional PAYER’S RTN box on Form 1099-INT, for financial institutions participating in the IRS program for direct deposit of refunds. Must be exactly 9 numeric digits. Set to null to clear. Nullable. |
| `form_1099_k_filer_type` | string | No | The filer type classification for Form 1099-K. One of: `PAYMENT_SETTLEMENT_ENTITY`, `ELECTRONIC_PAYMENT_FACILITATOR_OR_OTHER_THIRD_PARTY`. Nullable. |
| `form_1099_k_transaction_type` | string | No | The transaction type for Form 1099-K. One of: `PAYMENT_CARD_TRANSACTIONS`, `THIRD_PARTY_NETWORK_TRANSACTIONS`. Nullable. |
| `form_1042_s_chapter_3_status` | string | No | The Chapter 3 withholding status for Form 1042-S. One of 25 values: see [values/form-1042-s-chapter-3-status.md](../values/form-1042-s-chapter-3-status.md). Nullable. |
| `form_1042_s_chapter_4_status` | string | No | The Chapter 4 (FATCA) status for Form 1042-S. One of 37 values: see [values/form-1042-s-chapter-4-status.md](../values/form-1042-s-chapter-4-status.md). Nullable. |
| `cesop_psp_ids` | array of object | No | An array of CESOP Payment Service Provider (PSP) identifiers associated with the Filer. Set to null to clear. Nullable. |
| `cesop_psp_ids[].psp_id` | string | Yes | The Payment Service Provider (PSP) identifier. |
| `cesop_psp_ids[].country` | string | No | Two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for this PSP. |
| `cesop_psp_ids[].description` | string | No | Description of this PSP entry. |
| `cra_account_number` | string | No | The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) account number of the Filer. Used for Canadian MRDP reporting. Nullable. |
| `cra_account_number_type` | string | No | The type of Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) account number. Used for Canadian MRDP reporting. One of: `BN9`, `BN15`, `Trust`, `NR4`. Nullable. |
| `cra_representative_identifier` | string | No | The CRA representative identifier of the Filer. Used for Canadian MRDP reporting. Must be exactly 7 alphanumeric characters. Nullable. |
| `pse_name` | string | No | The name of the Payment Settlement Entity (PSE) associated with the Filer for Form 1099-K. Set to null to clear. Nullable. |
| `pse_telephone_number` | string | No | The telephone number of the Payment Settlement Entity (PSE) associated with the Filer for Form 1099-K. Set to null to clear. Nullable. |
| `dac7_receiving_member_state` | string | No | The EU member state designated to receive the DAC7 report. One of 27 values: see [values/dac7-receiving-member-state.md](../values/dac7-receiving-member-state.md). Nullable. |

Example request body:

```json
{"name":"Example HQ, Inc","tin":"12-3456789","ein":"82-1234567","tax_country_code":"US","vat_id":"DE123456789","vat_country":"DE","contact_name":"Jane Doe","contact_title":"Tax Department","contact_email":"tax@example.com","contact_phone":"+15551234567","giin":"ABCDEF.00000.LE.840","arn":"123456789012","rtn":"021000021","cra_account_number":"123456789","cra_representative_identifier":"ABC1234","pse_name":"Example PSE","pse_telephone_number":"+15559998888"}
```

**Response 200**: Filer updated successfully.

Returns the submitted body under `data`, plus:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The unique identifier (UUID) for the Filer. |
| `data.tenant_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The UUID of the tenant that owns this Filer. |
| `data.date_created` | string (date-time) | Yes | The date and time when the Filer was created. |
| `data.date_modified` | string (date-time) | Yes | The date and time when the Filer was last modified. |
| `data.vat_id_masked` | string | No | The masked VAT identification number of the Filer. |
| `data.disposition_method` | string | Yes | The default disposition method (cost basis accounting method) for Accounts under this Filer; an Account can override it with its own disposition_method. Supported disposition methods are HIFO, FIFO, LIFO, LOFO, and AUSTRIA. One of: `HIFO`, `FIFO`, `LIFO`, `LOFO`, `AUSTRIA`. |
| `data.is_default` | boolean | Yes | Whether this Filer is the default Filer for the tenant. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
